name: Grasslands National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets can hike the park, but not on prairie dog colonies.
summary: Leashed pets can hike the park, but not on prairie dog colonies.

excerpts.quote: Keep your pet on a leash at all times.
Pets are not permitted on prairie dog colonies.

dogRules.text: Pets are not permitted on prairie dog colonies.
Take extra care near bison when hiking with pets, especially May to August.
All campsites are pet-friendly; pet-friendly oTENTiks can be booked in the East and West Blocks.
